seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: May, November and December. Driest: April, June and July. Hottest: August (26.8°C average). Coolest: February (17.5°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: There are no nude or topless beaches, and it is illegal for anyone to be topless in public.
laws.heading: Public nudity

laws.rule: Do not become involved with drugs of any kind. Penalties for possessing or importing drugs include prison sentences of up to 25 years and heavy fines.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs penalties

laws.rule: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public outside of licensed premises.
laws.heading: Alcohol laws

laws.rule: It is illegal to possess or import weapons, including: air pistols catapults ammunition, including empty magazines There are severe penalties for breaking weapons laws.
laws.heading: Weapons

laws.rule: Same-sex relationships are legal in Bermuda. Bermuda allows same-sex domestic partnerships. Following a change in the law, same-sex partners can no longer marry – marriages before 14 March 2022 remain valid. Public attitudes are tolerant but conservative. Some people may not approve of same-sex couples showing affection in public. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers
